description: List the Belgian domains aggregated by this server, optionally filtered by topic or restricted to domains that are live and require no API key. Deprecated domains (whose upstream API has been retired) are hidden by default.

includeDeprecated.description: If true, also include domains whose upstream API has been retired and whose tools only return an upstream-unavailable error

includeTools.description: If true, include the exact tool names exposed by each returned domain

onlyPublicNoKey.description: If true, only return domains that are live and do not require an API key

query.description: Optional keyword filter across domain names, summaries, available data, use cases, notes, and tool names

name: belgium_list_domains
